english.note: Use this when regretting that a situation is unfortunate or that something has to happen, rather than expressing remorse over a past action.

examples.english: It’s such a shame things turned out this way; I really regret it.
examples.traditional: 件事搞成咁，真係覺得可惜。
examples.jyutping: gin6 si6 gaau2 sing4 gam2 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 ho2 sik1
